messages:
arya: FYI during the q-onboard sweep for narwhal-lite-q3 we started seeing the \"actions\" field survive as a string that contains NDJSON lines instead of a proper JSON array. downstream json.loads throws and clients retry. sample below.
ben: weird, NDJSON inside an array field? can you paste a repro + sample?
arya: repro curl: 
```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate \\
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $KEY\" \\
  -d '{"model":"narwhal-lite-q3","prompt":"invoke actions","max_tokens":140}'
```
sample bad (truncated):
```
{"id":"s1","output":"{\\\"actions\\\": \"[\\n{\\\"op\\\":\\\"create_ticket\\\"}\\n{\\\"op\\\":\\\"notify_team\\\"}\\n]\\\"}"}
```
So instead of `[{...},{...}]` we get NDJSON lines inside a stringified payload. our strict parser fails because there are missing commas between objects.
kai: any correlation with the recent compact-kv packing or the q3 PTQ pass?
arya: yes, it started right after enabling compact-kv packing + applying the q3 int8 recipe. token dumps show newline tokens injected at the array boundary in several traces. infra-bot: Canary job 4477779999-narwhal-lite-q3-canary created. status: running.
ben: short-term mitigations? we should avoid retries for side-effecting endpoints. retry storms are causing duplicate side-effects.
arya: short-term plan: 1) do NOT retry automatically for flagged side-effecting routes; 2) add a conservative NDJSON rescue path in the SDK that attempts to normalize a stringified NDJSON into a list only when the shape matches; 3) emit metric ndjson_contract_count and sample rescued payloads for manual triage.
kai: propose a conservative normalization: replace patterns of "}\n{" with "},{" and then attempt json.loads on the wrapped array. pseudocode: 
```
def ndjson_rescue(s):
    if isinstance(s, str) and s.strip().startswith('[') and '\n{' in s:
        candidate = s.replace('\n{', ',{').replace('}\n', '}},')
        # better: use regex to join object boundaries safely then json.loads
        try:
            parsed = json.loads(candidate)
            if isinstance(parsed, list) and all(isinstance(x, dict) for x in parsed):
                return parsed
        except Exception:
            return None
    return None
```
ben: add a strict schema validation after parsing (keys + types) before accepting the rescue, and only enable this rescue for non-side-effecting endpoints by default. log full raw payloads to telemetry.
arya: also add a canary lint rule: fail onboarding if ndjson_contract_count > 0.25% on the eval slice. block narwhal-lite-q3 from dedicated contract routes until we dig in.
kai: long-term: instrument the PTQ pipeline to dump token boundaries around contract-producing sequences and detect newline-token insertions correlated with compact-kv offset. maybe the tokenizer remap created a dedicated newline token sequence that the decoder now favors.
ben: I'll add the metric ndjson_contract_count and a sampled stream of rescued payloads to the eval board. also rate-limit any SDK-side rescue to avoid masking a real regression.
ops-bot: Incident created: #INC-2233 linked to canary job 4477779999.
arya: next steps: 1) deploy SDK rescue behind feature flag + telemetry, 2) block narwhal-lite-q3 on dedicated contract routes, 3) run a 5k golden-run diff vs narwhal-fp16 and compute contract pass delta + ndjson prevalence, 4) if reproduced, try small PTQ tweak to avoid newline insertion in contract tokens or a micro head tune. I'll post results here.
ben: agreed. If anyone else sees NDJSON or odd multiline object boundaries in contract fields, add to this thread so we can correlate across models.
kai: adding token-dump job to the canary artifacts now.
arya: thanks all 44d keeping this thread as the single place for the artifacts and final roll decision.
